selection: deterministic beginning/middle/end old ask-BBO mismatch cases plus first Gamma-added and June-extension markets and first observed empty-bid, equal-source-time, cross-side-late-ask, and out-of-order cases; a market may represent multiple classes

source_semantics_used.book: full snapshot replaces the token's bid and ask dictionaries; an empty side is a valid initialized side
source_semantics_used.equal_receive_timestamp: events with the same receive time are grouped; independent price levels at one source timestamp are order-independent; conflicting updates to the same side/price or a same-time snapshot conflict mark that side ambiguous; separate receive groups retain receive order
source_semantics_used.price_change: BUY updates bid, SELL updates ask; supplied size is the absolute size at that price; size zero removes that level
source_semantics_used.trade_execution: only the native token ask ladder is used; opposite-token complement prices are diagnostic and never executable
